items.statement_scope: Every finite polyhedral Lagrangian surface K embedded topologically in standard symplectic R4, with exactly four incident faces at every vertex, admits the stated Hamiltonian isotopy of smooth Lagrangians for t in (0,1] extending to a topological isotopy with endpoint K at t=0.
